Don’t Stream It, Buy It: The Walking Dead Seasons 1-11 for Just $10 (Digital Bundle)

By

John Finn

·

August 4, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:00
Instaread

If you’re tired of paying for a monthly subscription just to stream the original The Walking Dead series, this deal is for you. Right now you can pick up the The Walking Dead: The Complete Series digital bundle for just $9.99. That’s less than $1 a season.

Movie & TV Streaming

TV Dramas

The Walking Dead: The Complete Series is exactly what it sounds like. Buyers get access to all eleven seasons of the original The Walking Dead as part of a single collection.

Normally priced at $60, Fandango has currently slashed the price down to just $9.99. That’s for the complete bundle. All 11 seasons for just $10.

The Walking Dead: The Complete Series

All 11 seasons for $9.99

GET DEAL

While streaming can be a good way to watch your favorite series and shows, we never think it is worth paying for a subscription just to stream a single show or franchise.

In these situations we would always advise investing in a digital purchase so you can stream the episodes whenever you want, and without continually paying each month.

And, at $9.99 for the complete collection of the original The Walking Dead, this is one of those times when it can hardly even be called an investment.

For example, The Walking Dead is currently available to stream on Netflix. And with a subscription starting at $8.99/mo, buying the whole collection through this deal is just $1 more than a month of Netflix.

ScienceFiction & Fantasy TV Shows

As a reminder, AMC announced some major TWD news last week, confirming that it had agreed a new co-exclusive global streaming rights deal with Netflix.

Thanks to the new deal, all eleven seasons of the original series will be available to stream on Netflix and AMC+ beginning next year.

Missing spin-offs will be coming to Netflix on a permanent basis as well, making both Netflix and AMC+ complete solutions for the entire The Walking Dead Universe.

For those that do want continued access to the main show, and all of the spin-offs, then maybe this deal isn’t for you, as you will need to maintain a subscription anyway.

Then again, you can also currently pick up the Fear The Walking Dead: The Complete Collection on sale for $14.99. That’s all eight seasons of Fear the Walking Dead for just $15, and the complete collections of both TWD shows for under $25.

All 8 seasons for $14.99
